what: A single wordmark line spins twisted like a ribbon — the text is drawn into an image and mapped onto a plane split into 128 columns, with vertices twisted on the X axis by x position × 3.2 + time × .8 so front and back faces alternate as it flows. The plane is tilted -40° and laid out diagonally (WebGL, three)

options.twist: Twist per unit of x (radians), default 3.2
options.speed: Rotation angle per second (radians), default .8 — 0 means a frozen twist
options.--fx-ratio: Element aspect ratio (CSS variable), default 16 / 9 — the ribbon board is drawn inside this box

from.where: index.js join section (bottom) — original JoinUs3 PlaneGeometry(2.3,1) text plane (together with sns post-processing). Twist 3.2 · speed .8 · tilt -0.7rad are values tuned by eye on screen

note: three must be loaded globally (window.THREE) first — for builds above r160, load _fx/sprite-points-morph/three-global.js before three.cjs. Text color and typeface use the element’s computed style as is (they change when the skin is swapped and re-applied)
